A GUIDE, NOT A VERDICT

Finding words for a feeling.

Ten questions explore pleasantness, energy, tension, connection and other parts of your experience. A simple, hand-written matching system compares your answers with descriptions of common feelings and more complex emotional experiences.

The closest match and three alternatives are suggestions. This questionnaire has not been clinically validated, and the rankings are not probabilities or a mental health assessment. A close result can reflect overlapping feelings.

Only you can decide which words fit. Your answers stay in this tab’s memory and disappear when you reload or close it.
